reviewItem.question: For "loki do not wrap requests but send pure Protobuf from frontend v2 via scheduler to querier when `-frontend.encoding=protobuf`. 10956", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 now sends pure Protobuf requests via the scheduler to the querier instead of wrapping them.
